extDescription.message: Hide what you don't want on bazos.sk and spot the good prices. Everything stays in your browser.

filter_category_hint.message: Listings from the ticked Bazoš sections are hidden.

filter_keyword_hint.message: One word or phrase per line. Matched in the title and description, ignoring case and diacritics.

list_cheapest_empty.message: No priced listings seen today yet.

list_day_empty.message: Nothing today yet. Listings with the same model number are compared here.

list_products_none.message: No products yet. Add some in the settings.

options_filters_hint.message: Hidden listings disappear from Bazoš and from the lists. A banner above the results says how many were hidden.

options_auto_hint.message: Compares a listing with the median of similar listings in your history.

options_products_hint.message: One product per line. Every listing whose title contains the phrase is compared with the median of the others. The median counts from 5 listings.

options_threshold.message: Mark when the price is at least

options_saved.message: Saved. Reload the Bazoš page to apply it there.

options_history_hint.message: Only what you open on Bazoš yourself is stored, and only in this browser. Anything older than a year is removed on its own.

deals_none_comparable.message: {when}: {n} priced listings, but no two share a model number in the title, so there is nothing to compare.

deals_none_cheaper.message: {when}: {comparable} of {n} listings have something to compare with, but none is at least {pct} % under the median of similar ones.

options_mode_strict_hint.message: Only listings sharing a model number in the title (Samsung QE55Q60, Cybex Priam 2023). Fewer comparisons, nearly always right.

options_mode_loose_hint.message: Also listings without a model number when their titles are very alike (Šaty na stužkovú). More comparisons, sometimes of different things. Different model numbers never group.

deals_none_comparable_loose.message: {when}: {n} priced listings, but no two have titles alike enough, so there is nothing to compare.

badge_details_title.message: Click: what it was compared with

badge_suspicious_title.message: Suspiciously cheap: often a different product, a damaged item or a scam. Click to see what it was compared with.

details_hint.message: If something here does not belong, the comparison is wrong.

details_suspicious.message: More than 70 % under the median: check the condition, photos and seller. Not counted as a deal.

bar_no_deals.message: No good deals on this page.

bar_scan_title.message: Reads the next pages of this search, slowly one after another, saves their prices to history and shows the good deals among them.

options_page_hint.message: Good deals get a green highlight, are listed in the bar above the results, and their count shows on the add-on's icon. Listings more than 70 % under the median get an orange ⚠ and are not counted.

bar_scan_end.message: Read to the end of the search.

options_backup_hint.message: Move settings and price history to another computer. Importing replaces the settings and merges the history with the one you have. Import opens in a new tab, because a file picker would close this popup.

backup_imported.message: Imported {added} new listings, {updated} updated. Settings come from the backup.

backup_not_ours.message: this is not a Bazoš Rider backup

detail_suspicious.message: {pct} % cheaper than similar ones: suspiciously cheap

detail_nothing_hint.message: Your history has no listings alike enough. Open a search for similar ones and click Go through the next 10 pages; the usual price then shows here.

detail_no_price.message: no price given, nothing to compare
